title: Dinic's Algorithm Level Graph BFS & Augmenting Path

frames.description: BFS builds Layered Graph: Source S (Layer 0), U & V (Layer 1), W & X (Layer 2), Sink T (Layer 3).
frames.invariants: Residual edges are only admissible if level[v] == level[u] + 1

frames.description: DFS pushes blocking flow along path S -> U -> W -> T: bottleneck capacity = 4.
frames.invariants: Edge W->T is saturated, blocking further flow along this subpath

frames.description: DFS pushes blocking flow along S -> U -> X -> T (flow 6) and S -> V -> X -> T (flow 4). Total max flow = 14!
frames.invariants: Max-Flow Min-Cut Theorem: Total cut capacity == Max flow == 14
